structured.approach: I loaded the frontend-steps skill for FE-01, then read both contracted inputs. feat.tasks gives TSK-07 as the Frontend task on ap_portal, and org.engineering_stack gives the stack and CI. The G9 hook blocked shell for this step, so I checked the repository through file reads instead. I read .git/HEAD, the main, dev and feature/story refs and the feature/story reflog, then package.json, ci.mjs, the exports in index.js and tests/portal.test.js. I checked what I found against the step's tool view, which confirms write access and a clean tree. Then I wrote task.repo_access.md with a result table, the stack and CI as found, the TSK-07 file budget and three non-blocking notes. I used no connector because the inputs and the repository files held every fact I needed.

claims.text: The Frontend task for FEAT-ZD-48600 is TSK-07 (STORY-07), which renders the overdue risk table in the ap_portal repository.
Repository ap_portal is available locally and the agent identity has write access; the git status is clean.
No repository needs to be created: ap_portal already has the seed commit ff761ee.
Branch feature/story was created from dev at ff761ee and is checked out.
Branches main and dev both exist and both point at commit ff761ee.
ap_portal uses no Databricks, other workspace or database.
The stack is Node.js 22 with node:test, and the CI command is node ci.mjs.
CI passes only with coverage >= 90, no failures, no console.log or eval( lines and no line longer than 140 characters.
The current version is 2.3.0 in both src/ap_portal/index.js and package.json.
The current exports are VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary; TSK-07 must not change LABELS, formatAmount or renderAgingSummary.
The files in TSK-07's budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js, and all three exist.
Commit messages start with the story ID.

open_questions: RA-1 (non-blocking): The task convention is feature/<story>, but the spine created the branch feature/story, not feature/STORY-07. Should it be renamed? Interim: use feature/story and put STORY-07 at the start of every commit message.

RA-2 (non-blocking): Shell commands are not allowed in FE-01, so the agent did not run git status or CI itself. Write access and the clean tree come from the step's tool view; the branch refs were read from the .git files.
structured.summary: The ap_portal repository is available with write access, so FE-01's outcome is met. Branch feature/story was created from dev at ff761ee and is checked out, and main and dev point at the same commit. No repository needs to be created, and no Databricks workspace or database is needed. The CI command is node ci.mjs; it requires coverage of at least 90% and the static checks. The current version is 2.3.0, and all three files in TSK-07's budget exist. The repo_access file is written. There are two non-blocking questions: the branch name, and that write access was not checked with a shell command.

tool_input.command: git status && git branch -a && git log --oneline -3 && git remote -v && ls -la && ls src/ap_portal tests; test -w . && echo WRITABLE; node --version
tool_input.description: Check ap_portal repo state, branches and write access

tool_input.command: git -C ap-portal-sample status --short --branch; git -C ap-portal-sample branch --list; git -C ap-portal-sample log --oneline -3
